The court will require a greater foundation to establish the reliability of the records. Testimony that they were kept in the regular course of business does not meet Federal Rule of Evidence 803(6) or authenticate a computer process under Rule 901(b)(9); the proponent must also show timely creation from a knowledgeable source, a regular practice of making the records, and that the system produces accurate results. The defendant’s presence in court does not take those out-of-court records outside the hearsay rule or supply the missing reliability showing.

CONFIDENCE: 86
